title: Mixed Event — Carnation Recollection — Episode1 Still Not Quite Right

meta.Event Outline: Despite Kanade's persistent efforts to save Mafuyu, none of the songs she composes seem to leave an impression on her. Feeling like she's reached a dead end, Kanade heads to SEKAI for advice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<What? Still?
But this demo sounded amazing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I thought so too. I guess this one couldn't really get its hooks into Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But this is the fourth one now, right? Can't you say anything more than just, “I don't know”...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Ugh...! K's been working her butt off trying to make this song better, so you should do her a little courtesy and try a little harder.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's okay. I can make it again.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <This one didn't resonate with Yuki, so I'll keep trying until something does...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I guess we don't really have a choice. Also, K, have you been getting enough sleep lately? Take a break if you need one, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <All work and no play turns your brain into mush, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki, I'll try making a new demo but you'll have to wait until tomorrow night to hear it.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I have to get up early tomorrow, so bye.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I don't get it. Does Yuki just not understand how hard you've been working on these songs, K?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Calm down, girl. I'm sure she's trying her best, so let's just give her a little more time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Anyways, I'm gonna log off too.
See ya!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um, K? I know we just mentioned this, but don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I get that you want to make a song that can save Yuki, but I don't think rushing like this is the right answer.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It seems like she's been able to feel more lately, but it's still not enough...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (How do I actually make a song that can save Yuki...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, thinking about it won't get me anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just have to keep composing...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Until now, Kanade's songs made my chest ache or helped me relax when I listened to them.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(Even now, I feel something there...
A part of me that isn't at ease...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I don't know why that is...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Yeah. I like how this song's coming along...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Thanks for waiting, everyone.
The new demo's done.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<You're done already, K?
That was really fast...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, what's it like? I can't wait to hear it!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's nothing. Can I listen to it now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sure. I'll upload it to Nightcord... Oh...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Would it be okay with everyone if we listened to this together in SEKAI...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
The N25 Rangers are here to save the day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, cold as ice!
I saw this superhero cartoon on TV this morning, so I wanted to tell Miku about it is all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, yeah...
You really like dumb stuff like that, don't you...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But Mizuki does look more cheerful than before...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's pretty rare for you to suggest doing something like this, Kanade. I mean, we can just listen to it together on Nightcord.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to hear what you all have to say in person this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I know that Mafuyu can feel strong emotions in certain situations.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Like that time when we saw those cherry blossoms. She clearly spoke her mind and even smiled as we looked on...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That has to be some kind of hint. I don't want to let that go and miss my chance to make a song that can save her.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No way... Are you Megurine Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, that's me.
I just recently arrived in this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's nice to finally meet you all.
Miku's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Uh, right... It's nice to meet you too...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
First MEIKO and now Luka?
This place is starting to get crowded all the sudden.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you looking at me like that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is just me talking, but maybe you really are starting to change inside, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So what brings you all here today?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, we came here to listen to a demo of our next song together. Would you mind giving it a listen as well?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course. I'd love to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you. I'll get everything started.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, this intro's awesome...!
I love this vibe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, it really tells you what's going on from the start. Nice one, K!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I wonder what Mafuyu thinks.
I hope she feels something.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, I'm not sure it actually was...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I appreciate you all gathering here for this, but I need to start making fixes to this demo.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? But it was such a good song... Right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Maybe...
But I feel like it needs adjusting...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, when you're finished, I'd love to hear it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been trying to compose songs around what Mafuyu seems to be thinking or feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But lately, songs that I've been making this way haven't been striking a chord with her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to make something that really resonates with what she's feeling but...)
